BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, hâgîyn is the word for directly, in the straight way. In Ezekiel 42:12, the text says "And according to the doors of the chambers that [were] toward the south [was] a door in the head of the way."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hâgîyn I do not force more than it gives: directly, in the straight way.
